mapper.sql: inspection . id AS id, inspection.group_id AS groupId, inspection.department_id AS departmentId, departments.province_id AS provinceId, inspection.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, employees.position_id AS positionId, positions.name AS positionName, employees.photo AS profile, employees.code AS employeeCode, inspection.assessment_date AS assessmentDate, inspection.assessment_note AS assessmentNote, creator.full_name AS createdBy, egroups.name AS groupName, departments.name AS departmentName, provinces.name AS provinceName, inspection.created AS createdDate, IFNULL(inspection.service_percentage, 0) AS servicePercentage, IFNULL(inspection.enviroment_percentage, 0) AS environmentPercentage, IFNULL(inspection.product_percentage, 0) AS productPercentage, IFNULL(inspection.service_score, 0) AS serviceTotalScore, IFNULL(inspection.enviroment_score, 0) AS environtmentTotalScore, IFNULL(inspection.product_score, 0) AS productTotalScore

FROM inspection LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = inspection.employee_id LEFT JOIN positions ON positions.id = employees.position_id LEFT JOIN departments ON departments.id = inspection.department_id LEFT JOIN egroups ON egroups.id = inspection.group_id LEFT JOIN provinces ON provinces.id = departments.province_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = inspection.created_by
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, name AS name, shortcuts AS shortcuts, percentage AS percentage FROM inspection_group WHERE is_active = 1;
SELECT id AS id, name AS name FROM provinces WHERE is_active = 1;

SELECT quarters.id AS id, quarters.name AS name, quarter_months.start_date AS startDate, quarter_months.to_date AS toDate FROM quarters INNER JOIN quarter_months ON quarter_months.quarter_id = quarters.id WHERE quarters.is_active = 1;

SELECT id AS id, name AS name, inspection_group_id AS inspectionGroupId, score AS score, IFNULL(SUM(full_score),0) AS fullScore, IFNULL(percentage,0) AS percentage FROM sub_inspection WHERE is_active = 1 AND inspection_group_id = #{id} GROUP BY id;
SELECT id AS id, sub_inspection_id AS subInspectionGroupId, name AS name FROM sub_sub_inspection WHERE is_active = 1 AND sub_inspection_id = #{id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection ( group_id, employee_id, department_id, province_id, assessment_date, assessment_note, created, created_by, is_active, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{inspection.groupId}, #{inspection.employeeId}, #{inspection.departmentId}, #{inspection.provinceId}, #{inspection.assessmentDate}, #{inspection.assessmentNote}, NOW(), #{inspection.createdBy}, 1, NOW()NULL, #{inspection.modifiedBy} );
mapper.update: UPDATE inspection SET group_id = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.groupId}, employee_id = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.employeeId}, department_id = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.departmentId}, province_id = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.provinceId}, assessment_date = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.assessmentDate}, assessment_note = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.assessmentNote}, service_percentage = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.servicePercentage}, enviroment_percentage = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.enviromentPercentage}, product_percentage = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.productPercentage}, service_score = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.serviceScore}, enviroment_score = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.enviromentScore}, product_score = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.productScore}, modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{inspectionScoreUpdate.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_inspection_form ( inspection_id, sub_inspection_id, total_score, percentage, is_active ) VALUES ( #{subInspectionRequest.inspectionId}, #{subInspectionRequest.subInspectionId}, #{subInspectionRequest.totalScore}, #{subInspectionRequest.percentage}, 1 );

INSERT INTO inspection_score ( inspection_id, sub_sub_inspection_id, score, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{inspectionScore.inspectionId}, #{inspectionScore.subSubInspectionId}, #{inspectionScore.score}, NOW(), #{inspectionScore.createdBy}, 1 );
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(score),0) FROM inspection_score WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `inspection_id` = #{inspectionId} AND `sub_sub_inspection_id` IN(SELECT `id` FROM `sub_sub_inspection` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `sub_inspection_id` = #{subInspectionId})
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(`score`),0) FROM `inspection_score` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `inspection_id` = #{inspectionId} AND `sub_sub_inspection_id` = #{subSubInspectionId};
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(`percentage`),0) FROM `inspection_score` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `inspection_id` = #{inspectionId} AND `sub_sub_inspection_id` = #{subSubInspectionId};

SELECT , (SELECT `full_score` FROM `inspection_group` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `id` = 1 LIMIT 1) AS serviceFullScore, (SELECT `full_score` FROM `inspection_group` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `id` = 2 LIMIT 1) AS environtmentFullScore, (SELECT `full_score` FROM `inspection_group` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `id` = 3 LIMIT 1) AS productFullScore
WHERE inspection.is_active = 1 AND inspection.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(inspection.id) as qc, egroups.name AS groupName, departments.name AS departmentName, provinces.name AS provinceName, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) AS servicePercentage, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.enviroment_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) AS environtmentPercentage, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) AS productPercentage, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) AS totalPercentage, IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_score + inspection.enviroment_score + inspection.product_score),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) AS totalScore, (CASE WHEN IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) > 94 THEN 'A' WHEN IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) >= 90 THEN 'B' WHEN IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) >= 80 THEN 'C' WHEN IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) >= 70 THEN 'D' WHEN IFNULL(IFNULL(SUM(inspection.service_percentage + inspection.enviroment_percentage + inspection.product_percentage),0) / COUNT(inspection.id),0) < 70 THEN 'F' END) AS rank
GROUP BY inspection.department_id ORDER BY inspection.department_id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
